extensions.name: Internet Archive comics
extensions.description: Comic strips, comic books and children's papers from the Internet Archive that are in the public domain by age: published more than 95 years ago, and marked public domain or openly licensed, or in a set the Archive dated itself.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: BCcampus Open Textbooks
extensions.description: Creative Commons (CC BY, BY-SA, BY-NC, BY-NC-SA) or public domain, as each book states: open textbooks from BCcampus' collection for colleges, universities and the trades, read chapter by chapter.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: Blender open movies
extensions.description: CC BY and CC BY-SA: Blender Studio's open movies, from Elephants Dream and Big Buck Bunny to Singularity, played from Wikimedia Commons.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: ESA/Hubble and ESA/Webb
extensions.description: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0: the European Space Agency's Hubble and Webb videos (Hubblecasts, zooms and pans, animations, Space Sparks), credited as ESA/Hubble and ESA/Webb give them; videos whose page names another licence are left out.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: Europeana
extensions.description: Public domain and open licences only (Public Domain Mark, CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA): films and recordings from Europe's archives, libraries and museums through Europeana, each credited to the institution that holds it. Needs your own free API key from your europeana.eu account, entered in this source's settings.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: fyyd podcasts
extensions.description: A podcast directory: finds podcasts in fyyd's open index of public feeds, and lists the most active ones in a language. Raygun reads each podcast's own feed. No account needed.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: GNU Manuals
extensions.description: GNU Free Documentation License (and other free licences, as each manual states): the GNU Project's manuals for Bash, Coreutils, Emacs, Gawk, Make, Tar and more, read node by node from www.gnu.org.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: Green Tea Press
extensions.description: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, CC BY-NC-SA 3.0, CC BY-NC 3.0 or CC BY 4.0, as each book states: Allen B. Downey's free textbooks on programming, statistics, data science and systems (Think Python, Think Stats, Think Bayes and more), read chapter by chapter with their code.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: Project Gutenberg
extensions.description: Over 70,000 free public-domain books from Project Gutenberg, split into chapters to read like a novel.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: Gutenberg open audiobooks
extensions.description: Public-domain books from Project Gutenberg read by neural voices: the Project Gutenberg Open Audiobook Collection, about 4,800 books made with Microsoft and MIT, kept by the Internet Archive. Free under the Project Gutenberg License; each book is one recording.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: Incompetech
extensions.description: Kevin MacLeod's music, free under CC BY 4.0: his whole catalogue from incompetech.com, searchable by title, genre, feel and instruments, with his collections as albums and charts by genre and mood. Credit: Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com).
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: Internet Archive
extensions.description: Public domain and Creative Commons: netlabel, Musopen and Free Music Archive recordings under a Creative Commons licence or public-domain mark, films in the public domain by age or by a mark that holds up, and MIT OpenCourseWare's lectures as MIT uploaded them (Creative Commons, mostly BY-NC-SA), from the Internet Archive.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: Last.fm
extensions.description: Music data from Last.fm, credited to Last.fm and linked to its pages, under its API terms (non-commercial use; Last.fm's images and audio aren't used): the songs most played on Last.fm worldwide and in your country, genre charts and genre and mood songs, genres for songs, artists like an artist, an artist's most played songs, song radios and artist biographies. Needs your own free API key, created at last.fm/api/account/create and entered in this source's settings.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: LibriVox
extensions.description: Free public-domain audiobooks read by LibriVox volunteers: found by title, author or genre through the Internet Archive and LibriVox's own catalogue, and played chapter by chapter.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: ListenBrainz
extensions.description: Charts and recommendations under CC0 from ListenBrainz, the open listening-history project of the MetaBrainz Foundation: the songs most listened to this week, month, year and of all time, genre radios, artists like an artist, an artist's best-known songs and fresh releases, and radios of similar songs. No account needed. Cover art from the Cover Art Archive.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: Live Music Archive
extensions.description: Concert recordings from the Internet Archive's Live Music Archive, by trade-friendly artists who allow free non-commercial sharing of their shows: songs, and whole concerts as albums. Shows an artist keeps to streaming only are left out.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: Library of Congress
extensions.description: Public domain in the United States only: films published more than 95 years ago and sound recordings published more than 100 years ago, from the Library of Congress's online collections (Edison's films and records, the Spanish-American War, early animation, the Westinghouse Works, early San Francisco and New York, the National Screening Room); items whose rights statement names a restriction are left out.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: Loyal Books
extensions.description: Free public-domain audiobooks from Loyal Books (Books Should Be Free), by popularity and genre, played chapter by chapter from each book's feed.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: MusicBrainz
extensions.description: Metadata under CC0 and CC BY-SA: song, album and artist details, genres, discographies, artist facts and song credits from the open MusicBrainz database, with artist summaries from Wikipedia. Cover art from the Cover Art Archive. For tagging and finding music.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: National Archives
extensions.description: Unrestricted US government records: films from the National Archives Catalog, only those the National Archives marks free of use and access restrictions. Needs your own API key, which the National Archives gives on request by email to Catalog_API@nara.gov; enter it in this source's settings.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: NASA Image and Video Library
extensions.description: Public domain (NASA media): launches, missions, briefings and science videos from NASA's Image and Video Library, with captions.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: YouTube enhancements
extensions.description: Blocks ads, keeps playing in the background, skips sponsored segments and more on YouTube. Adapted from NouTube.
extensions.author: Raygun (adapted from NouTube by nonbili)

extensions.name: National Park Service
extensions.description: Public domain (US government works): videos from the National Park Service's multimedia library, with captions and audio-described versions, only those credited to the Park Service, a park or another federal agency (or not credited at all) that name no one else's rights. Needs your own free API key from nps.gov/subjects/developer/get-started.htm, entered in this source's settings.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: OpenStax
extensions.description: CC BY 4.0 or CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, as each book states: free, peer-reviewed college textbooks from OpenStax at Rice University, in English and Spanish, on mathematics, science, social sciences, humanities, business, computer science and nursing, read section by section with their figures and formulas.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: Pepper&Carrot
extensions.description: David Revoy's fantasy webcomic about a young witch and her cat, free under CC BY 4.0, in its readers' many translations.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: Podcast Index
extensions.description: A podcast directory: searches the Podcast Index, the open index of millions of public podcast feeds, and lists what's trending. Needs your own free API key and secret from api.podcastindex.org, entered in this source's settings. Raygun reads each podcast's own feed.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: Saylor Academy Open Textbooks
extensions.description: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0: Saylor Academy's open textbooks on business, economics, law, psychology, sociology, chemistry, writing and more, read chapter by chapter.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: Standard Ebooks
extensions.description: Public domain (CC0): classic books in Standard Ebooks' carefully produced editions, read chapter by chapter.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: Twitch
extensions.description: Live channels, past broadcasts and clips from Twitch's official API: what's live now by viewers, by category and language, channel search, and each channel's page with its stream, videos and top clips. They play in Twitch's own player in Raygun's browser, as Twitch's developer agreement requires; Twitch's channel page there has the chat. Needs the Client ID and Client Secret of an application you register at dev.twitch.tv/console.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: Wikibooks
extensions.description: CC BY-SA 4.0: open textbooks and manuals written by Wikibooks' volunteers, on programming, science, mathematics, languages and more, read chapter by chapter.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: Wikimedia Commons
extensions.description: Public domain and Creative Commons: recordings and videos from Wikimedia Commons, with subtitles where people wrote them.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: Wikisource
extensions.description: Public domain and Creative Commons: novels, stories, poems and plays from English Wikisource, proofread by its volunteers.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: xkcd
extensions.description: Every xkcd comic by Randall Munroe, from the first to today's, each a chapter of its own (CC BY-NC 2.5).
extensions.author: Raygun
